Bidders offers to liable to reject if they not upload any documents asked int he bid, ATC if any TERMS AND ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT (AMC) FOR COMPUTERS, PRINTERS & PERIPHE RALS OF GE (AF) BHISIANA FOR A PERIOD OF TWELVE MONTHS Name of Work: Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for Computers, Printers & UPS of GE (AF) Bhisiana. 1. The contract covers the following IT assets of GE (AF) Bhisiana: Ser No Items A/U Qty Computers with Accessories complet 24 1 Nos e set 17 2 Printers (Jet/Laser Jet Printers) Nos 24 3 UPS Nos Note: Quantities may vary as per actual holdings/procurement and routine disposal during the contract pe riod. 2. During the contract, the client shall not allow any other firm/company or individual other than the contractor to repair or service the machines covered under this contract. In case of breach of this condition , any amount paid to the contractor shall stand forfeited and no claim shall be entertained. 3. Under the contract, the contractor shall depute its representative to service the machinery. The re presentative shall open the machine including its critical moving parts and shall clean and service them pr operly as required. The representative shall ensure smooth working of the machine and shall obtain a certi ficate of satisfactory service from the client after the service is carried out on each occasion of the contrac t. 4. In case of defective working of a machine, the contractor may, at its own cost, rectify the faults ev en if the service is extra to the scheduled four services. However, in case the defect is due to mishandling, careless operation or due to replacement of parts already recommended, the contractor shall not be respo nsible for malfunctioning of the machines. 5. Minor spare parts including keyboard, mouse, connecting cables, data cables, replacements, conn ecting parts etc. shall be replaced by the vendor as part of routine maintenance services and/or repair duri ng the course of normal complaints. Antivirus or any other software provided by this office is also required to be installed by the vendor whenever asked. 6. Technical advice shall be given by the vendor for all unserviceable computers and shall include on -site assessment, identifying parts to be replaced/upgraded and making cost assessment of repairs/replac ement/renewals of peripherals and parts not covered under Para 5 above.

7. Vendor must detail qualified technician every alternate day to carry out repair/service work. 8. Vendor must provide alternate IT equipment, if it takes 48 hours and more to repair the defective I T equipment. 9. Vendor must have a repair shop within 30–50 km radius. 10. Pre-Bid Meeting (Mandatory for Participation): (a) Attendance at the pre-bid meeting shall be mandatory for all prospective bi dders intending to participate in the bid for the Annual Maintenance Contract (A MC) of computers, printers and UPS. (b) The date, time and venue/mode of the pre-bid meeting shall be as specified in the GeM bid or notified through the GeM portal. (c) The bidders shall familiarise themselves with the equipment inventory, scop e of maintenance, technical requirements, service response time and other cont ractual conditions during the pre-bid meeting. (d) Bidders shall ensure that their authorised representatives attend the meetin g and submit the attendance details as prescribed by the Buyer. (e) Bidders who do not attend the mandatory pre-bid meeting shall be liable for disqualification, subject to applicable GeM terms and procurement rules. SCHEDULED SERVICES 11. All machines shall be serviced once in three months to include: (a) General replacement servicing/checking potential faults. (b) Install OS updates, antivirus, upgrades and updating drivers for printers/scanners/fax machines or a ny other authorized IT peripherals. (c) Removing potentially harmful viruses/Trojans/threats from operating system hard drives. (d) Partitioning of hard disk and locking utilities as per Army Cyber Security Policy 2017 viz. disabling U SB drives, disabling internal CD/DVD writers of PCs, disabling Wi-Fi access etc. as orders are updated fro m time to time. 12. Initial commissioning of newly procured computers and peripherals including operating system in stallation, updates/patches and integration into GE (AF) Bhisiana network and configuring of printers/scann ers/fax machines on the PC. REPAIRS & EMERGENCY SERVICES 13. Routine maintenance under this contract and any dysfunctions/failure of the machine, after compl aint has been reported, will be attended within 24 hours of receipt of repair call from GE (AF) Bhisiana. 13. The machine shall be serviced on any working day but in accordance with the scheduled services (Quarterly) under the contract. 14. There being heavy load of complaints, 01 x technician will be deputed on all working days and 01 x technician for carrying out scheduled service and Emergency services mentioned above. The technicians shall be responsible for proper administration of local area network (LAN) in GE office and enforcing hygien e measures in all computers. Rs 600 per day will be levied, in case of absence. 15. If vendor is unable to repair the PC/Printer/UPS in the office premises and wants to take the same to his workshop for repair, it is responsibility of the vendor to provide alternative PC/Printer/UPS for smooth functioning of office work till the PC/Printer/UPS gets repaired. MAINTENANCE OF RECORD OF WORK DONE

16. The vendor shall maintain a record of all computers repaired/serviced during the tenure of this A MC. Record of all minor spare parts fixed/replaced during the AMC shall be maintained. The vendor shall o btain signatures of the computer user/custodian and Cantt Area Cyber Security Officer/designated in-charg e on the same day for work carried out. Vendor shall also enter the repairs carried out in the log book of th e computer/IT access. Absence of the same payment to the vendor may be withheld for the quarters. 17. The original and one copy of the contract may be returned duly stamped and signed by the autho rity. The original copy and bill shall be sent back for release of payment and the company shall retain one copy for their records. 18. All disputes shall be subject to Bathinda jurisdiction only. 19. The charges are payable on quarterly basis through electronic fund transfer. 20. The unserviceable parts as replaced will be property of GE (AF) Bhisiana. 21. The contract can be terminated by the GE by giving one month notice, without assigning any reason. .
